info.name: ServiceDesk API
info.description:
Requests and tests for the ServiceDesk mock (src/servicedesk/app.py).

Start the service with `python src/servicedesk/app.py`, then run the collection in order (Collection Runner). Folder 00 resets the seed data so results are repeatable.

Select the "ServiceDesk Local" environment (ServiceDesk.postman_environment.json) before running: it holds requesterToken, engineerToken and changeManagerToken (from README.md). Each request picks the least-privileged token it needs.
